study_identification_part.si_4_title: Age-atypical brain functional networks in autism spectrum disorder: a normative modeling approach

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (resting-state fMRI; ASD and TD participants).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Using a world-wide multi-site database known as Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange, we analyzed individuals with ASD and typically developed (TD) controls"; "All the data analyzed in this study were sourced from the ABIDE dataset"

answer.ABIDE: TD for normative model; ASD for deviation analysis/testing

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: TD group used to derive normative mean/SD; ASD group evaluated against TD norm.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Using a world-wide multi-site database known as Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange, we analyzed individuals with ASD and typically developed (TD) controls"; "These statistical norms were then used to compute the Z'-scores of each functional connection and the W-scores of each brain network for each patient with ASD"
